verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an official CLI at clerk.com/cli, and a probe confirms the page exists. Its documented commands include `clerk init` (detects the framework and scaffolds auth), `clerk impersonate`, `clerk deploy` (domain, OAuth and DNS setup), local webhook relay with offline signature verification, and a one-command setup that connects the Clerk MCP server to AI clients, so the CLI clearly serves AI-native workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of agent-friendly behaviors such as machine-readable output or non-interactive mode.
